---
title: "Direct vs Indirect SQL"
---

Create DuckDB driver
```{r}
drv <- duckdb::duckdb()
drv
```


Create in-memory DuckDB database & connect to it
```{r}
con <- DBI::dbConnect(drv)
con
```


Create sample dataset
```{r} 
ds <- tibble::tribble(
    ~x, ~y,
    1, 10,
    2, 20,
    3, 30
)
ds
```


Add sample dataset to DB
```{r}
DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "ds", ds)
DBI::dbListTables(con)
```


Direct SQL
```{r}
DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM ds WHERE y > 20")
```


Indirect SQL vis dplyr verbs
```{r}
# create tbl object first
db_ds <- dplyr::tbl(con, "ds")
db_ds

# use tbl object to create query
query <- db_ds |> dplyr::filter( y > 20)

# show query
query |> dplyr::show_query()

# run query
dplyr::collect(query)
```
